select tcp.project_code,tcp.project_name, ta.id as contract_id,ta.agreement_code as contract_code,ta.agreement_name as contract_name,ta.agreement_sign_date as contract_time,ta.vendor_id,ta.scheme_id, tv.enterprise_city_code as area_code,tv.enterprise_city_name as area_name, taml.materials_code as cost_item_code,taml.materials_name as cost_item_name,taml.brand as cost_item_brand,taml.specification as cost_item_specification,taml.unit_measurement as cost_item_unit, tbi.tax_unit_price,tbi.not_tax_unit_price from tb_procurement_plan tpp left join tb_contract_planning tcp on tcp.plan_id = tpp.id left join tb_contract_planning_split tcps on tpp.id = tcps.procurement_plan_id left join tb_agreement ta on tcps.id = ta.contract_split_id left join tb_vendor tv on ta.vendor_id = tv.id left join (select aml.agreement_id,aml.materials_code,aml.materials_name,aml.brand,ml.specification,ml.unit_measurement from tb_agreement_materials_list aml left join tb_materials_list ml on aml.materials_code = ml.materials_code) taml on ta.id = taml.agreement_id left join (select bi.scheme_id,bi.vendor_id,blq.materials_code,blq.tax_unit_price,blq.not_tax_unit_price from tb_bidding_info bi left join tb_bidding_list_quotation blq on bi.id = blq.bidding_info_id) tbi on ta.vendor_id = tbi.vendor_id and ta.scheme_id =tbi.scheme_id and taml.materials_code = tbi.materials_code
ta.agreement_state = '3'
AND taml.materials_code like concat('%',#{costItemCode},'%')
AND tv.enterprise_city_name like concat('%',#{areaName},'%')
AND ta.agreement_sign_date >= #{startTime} and ta.agreement_sign_date < #{endTime}
